as_written_in_papers.quote: | 5 | 1 week/8 years | M/unknown (adopted) | c.1012G>T, p.Glu338* | OTU | Right arytenoid mass, inflammatory fibroepithelial polyp, frontal lobe punctate, & small vessel CNS vasculitis | Died | (4) |

cases.statement: One carrier, known only from a one-line literature table in PMID 39845949 (Table 2 case 5): an adopted boy, onset at 1 week, age 8 years, with a right arytenoid mass, an inflammatory fibroepithelial polyp, frontal-lobe punctate lesions and small-vessel CNS vasculitis; the treatment column reads 'Died'. The table's blanket note says all cases were heterozygous. The primary source is the table's reference (4), Aeschlimann et al. 2018 (PMID 29317407 in the reference list), which is not in this batch.

people.label: Table 2 #5
people.key_phenotypes: onset at 1 week; right arytenoid mass; inflammatory fibroepithelial polyp; frontal lobe punctate lesions; small-vessel CNS vasculitis; died

phenotype_specificity.statement: No case description in this paper. The table lists only HA20 patients with brain parenchymal lesions or abnormal CSF findings; it gives no information on other causes considered or excluded.

quotes.quote: Table 2 shows characteristics of only HA20 patients with abnormal lesions in the brain parenchyma or abnormal CSF findings.

segregation.statement: Not reported. The child was adopted and ethnicity is unknown, so family history is unavailable in this source.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide substitution creating a stop codon, p.(Glu338Ter) per the batch HGVS (agrees with the table's p.Glu338*), in the OTU domain per the table. The paper's general statement on mechanism is reduced A20 expression (haploinsufficiency).

quotes.quote: Expression of the A20 protein encoded by the mutated TNFAIP3 gene is reduced by half, leading to dysregulation of inflammatory cytokines, such as tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and interleukin-1 (IL-1) (2).

concerns: Appears only in a literature-review table without a case description, transcript or family data. The primary report (reference 4, Aeschlimann 2018, PMID 29317407) is not in the batch; the panel should read it before adjudicating.
Zygosity rests on the table's blanket note ('The genotype of all cases was heterozygous'), not a statement about this case.
The table lists current age '8 years' and treatment 'Died' in the same row; the timing is unclear from this source.
39125844 (review, in this batch) was searched for c.1012, Glu338 and E338 with no hits.
Transcript not stated; the batch uses NM_001270508.2.
notes_for_panel: Evidence here is one table row in a review. All case-level evidence (phenotype detail, family, testing) has to come from the primary paper, which is not in this batch.
